title.zh: 被围住为变化定下界：从某步起每步被围住时，活跃者连同有生起或止息的步不多于那一步所立者的总水平；全部八个前提之下，从某步起被围住时与有限世界中计数的规律相同，恰是计数表、没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起与从第 0 步起的变化界；从某步起被围住时，在八个前提的每个选择之下，计数的规律是不被围住时的规律，在选择包含平衡、体现与耗散时再加上从某步起的变化界与此后没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起；在有限世界中，每个选择之下计数的规律是每步至多有某数活跃的计数表，在选中平衡与体现、并选中只有活跃者给予或耗散时再加没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起，在选中平衡、体现与耗散时再加从第 0 步起的变化界；有限世界与从某步起被围住的世界恰在选择约束变化且约束计数时有相同的计数规律
title.en: Enclosure bounds change: with every step from some step on enclosed, the relata active together with the steps at which something arose or ceased stay within the total standing at that step; under all eight premises the laws of counting under enclosure from some step on and in finite worlds are the same: the tally, that nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active, and a change bound from the first step; with enclosure from some step on, under each selection of the eight premises the laws of counting are those without it, and where balance, embodiment and dissipation are selected also a change bound from some step and that from then on nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active; in finite worlds, under each selection the laws of counting are those of a tally with at most some number active at each step, adding that nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active where balance and embodiment are selected with only active relata giving or with dissipation, and a change bound from the first step where balance, embodiment and dissipation are selected; finite worlds and worlds enclosed from some step on have the same laws of counting under a selection exactly when it bounds change and binds counting

claim.zh: 称计数从第 T 步起在变化界 B 之内（ChangeBound T B n c a），若对 T 之后的每一步 t，n t 连同自 T 至 t 之前 c 或 a 为正的步数（occurrences）不多于 B。变化界之内变化不复现（ChangeBound.not_recurring）；从第 T 步起的变化界是从第 0 步起的变化界，大出 T 与 T 之前的计数（ChangeBound.from_zero、changeBound_iff_zero）。被围住为变化定下界：在有活动的普查、关系项都体现、流平衡且耗散的世界中，从第 T 步起每步被围住（Flow.Enclosed）时，普查的计数从 T 起在第 T 步所立者的总水平之内（World.enclosure_bounds_change）：被围住的步上所立者的总水平不升，有生起或止息的步上至少降一（Flow.standing_never_rises、Flow.change_lowers），活跃的体现关系项都立着（World.length_le_stock）。反过来，被围住的队列（EnclosedQueue、World.enclosedQueue）以自然数为成员，成员恰在队中时活跃并立着一，队首另立着变化界余下的超出成员数的部分；队首参与每一步，从每个成员取用其水平所降的，给予其水平所升的。它的每一步都被其跨度围住（World.enclosedQueue_enclosed），在从第 0 步起在变化界之内、没有成员加入空队的每个计数表之下满足全部八个前提（World.enclosedQueue_premised：平衡由构造，每个有变化的步上所立者降一，所以耗散成立）。所以对计数的一个逐点的性质，在满足全部八个前提、从某步起每步被围住的每个世界的普查中成立，恰当它对每个没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起、从第 0 步起在某个变化界之内的计数表成立（World.enclosed_counting）。这样的队列从不超过第 B + B·B 个成员（Queue.reached、ChangeBound.joins、ChangeBound.reach），放在这些位置上（placesBelow、FiniteQueue、World.finiteQueue）是满足全部八个前提的有限世界（World.finiteQueue_finite、World.finiteQueue_premised），所以有限世界中计数的规律相同（World.finite_counting），从某步起被围住的世界与有限世界有相同的计数规律（World.enclosed_iff_finite_counting）。在有限的队列中耗散起约束，这个界可以达到：第 0 步替换一个成员时，队首从全部位置的封闭家族取用两个单位（World.replaced、World.finite_dissipation_binds），第 0 步所立者总共为二，此后一个成员连同一步变化恰为二（World.replaced_attains）。变化不复现不能加强为终结之步：若每个从第 0 步起在变化界之内、没有成员加入空队的计数表都有一步之后不再变化，或每个满足八个前提、活动可判定的有限世界都有一步之后不再生起，有限全知原则 LPO 成立，见证在布尔序列的第一个真处替换一个成员（Swap、ChangeBound.lpo_of_ends、World.lpo_of_finite_ends）。在每个前提选择之下：被围住的一步上只需平衡、耗散与体现，没有关系项活跃时那里所立者的总水平为零，任何成员开始立着都会使它下降，所以没有生起，不论谁给予、谁取用（World.enclosed_binds_counting）。被围住的队列不论计数都只在活跃时取用（World.enclosedQueue_taking），它的耗散逐步成立，只要求该步没有成员加入空队、前后两步都在所立者之内（World.enclosedQueue_dissipatesOn）。在第 T 步闭合的队列（EnclosedQueue.closing、World.closingQueue）在 T 之前让每个关系项与队首各交换一个单位，所以 T 之前没有家族封闭；它平衡（World.closingQueue_balanced），从 T 起它的流就是被围住的队列的流（World.closing_flows），每步被围住（World.closingQueue_enclosed），从 T 起有变化界、此后没有成员加入空队时它耗散（World.closingQueue_dissipative）。称一个选择约束变化（World.BoundsChange），若它选中平衡、体现与耗散。所以在从某步起每步被围住的世界中，在八个前提的每个选择之下，对计数的一个逐点的性质在满足这个选择的每个世界的每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个满足两个条件的计数表成立：选择约束计数时，没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起；选择约束变化时，从某步 T 起变化在一个界之内，且从 T 起没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起（World.enclosed_counting_under）。后一个条件须带着它的步：变化界之内变化不复现（ChangeBound.not_recurring），这本身不给出这样的一步。不选耗散时，被围住不约束计数：变化界为零的被围住的队列实现其余条件下的每个计数表；缺平衡或缺体现时，不流动的队列每步都被围住（World.still_enclosed）。所以被围住时，从某步起的变化界（连同此后没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起）是一个选择之下的计数规律，恰当这个选择约束变化（World.enclosed_change_bound_iff）：不约束变化时，每步多一个的计数由满足这个选择、从某步起被围住的世界实现。有限世界中每步被围住（World.Finite.enclosed），所以在那里平衡、体现与耗散本身就约束计数（World.enclosed_binds_counting），并给出从第 0 步起的变化界（World.enclosure_bounds_change），每个普查至多计到关系项那么多（World.Finite.census_bounded）。反过来，把队列的成员依次排在一圈 N 个位置上（Ring.slot：第 k+1 个成员坐在第 k 个的下一个位置，满一圈回到第一个位置），相距不到一圈的成员位置不同（Ring.slot_add、Ring.slot_ne、Ring.slot_inj）；每步至多有 M 个在队中时，一圈 2M+1 个位置（Ring.size）容得下任一步前后在队中的成员，所以环列出每步被占的位置，各一次（Ring.census），计到队列所计的（Ring.counts）。不立任何东西的环满足除体现外的全部前提（World.ring、World.ring_meets），每个位置被占时立着一的环满足除平衡外的全部前提（World.embodiedRing、World.embodiedRing_meets），其队首的位置再从每个位置取用其水平所降的、给予其所升的，满足除耗散外的全部前提，没有成员加入空队时也满足只有活跃者给予（World.balancedRing、World.balancedRing_acting、World.balancedRing_meets）。所以在有限世界中，在八个前提的每个选择之下，对计数的一个逐点的性质在满足这个选择的每个有限世界的每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个满足三个条件的计数表成立：每步至多有某数个活跃；选择约束计数或约束变化时，没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起；选择约束变化时，从第 0 步起变化在一个界之内（World.finite_counting_under）。“没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起”在有限世界中是一个选择之下的规律，恰当这个选择选中平衡与体现，并选中只有活跃者给予或耗散（World.finite_counting_binds_iff）；从第 0 步起的变化界是规律，恰当这个选择约束变化：每步替换一个成员的计数由满足其余任一选择的有限的环实现（World.finite_change_bound_iff）。所以 256 个选择在有限世界中给出三种规律。有限世界与从某步起被围住的世界在一个选择之下有相同的计数规律，恰当这个选择约束变化且约束计数（World.enclosed_iff_finite_counting_under）：不约束变化时，每步多一个的计数由每步被围住的世界实现，不由任何有限世界实现；约束变化而不约束计数时，一个关系项在被围住之前从无到有地生起（Queue.lone_settles）由被围住的世界实现，不由任何有限世界实现。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Say that B bounds change from step T (ChangeBound T B n c a) when at every step t from T on, n t together with the number of steps from T before t at which c or a is positive (occurrences) is at most B. Within a change bound change does not recur (ChangeBound.not_recurring); a change bound from step T is one from the first step, larger by T and the counts before T (ChangeBound.from_zero, changeBound_iff_zero). Enclosure bounds change: in a world with a census of activity whose relata are all embodied, with a balanced, dissipative flow and every step from T on enclosed (Flow.Enclosed), the total standing at T bounds the change of the census from T (World.enclosure_bounds_change): across an enclosed step the total standing never rises, and it falls by at least one at every step at which something arises or ceases (Flow.standing_never_rises, Flow.change_lowers), while the embodied relata active all stand (World.length_le_stock). Conversely an enclosed queue (EnclosedQueue, World.enclosedQueue) has natural numbers as members, active and standing at one exactly while in the queue, its front also standing at what the bound leaves beyond one for each member; the front takes part at every step, taking from each member what its standing loses and giving each what it gains. Every step is enclosed by its span (World.enclosedQueue_enclosed), and the queue meets all eight premises under every tally with a change bound from the first step in which nothing joins an empty queue (World.enclosedQueue_premised: balance holds by construction, and what stands falls by one at every step of change, so dissipation holds). So a pointwise property of the counts holds of the census of every world meeting all eight premises with every step from some step on enclosed exactly when it holds of every tally with a change bound from the first step in which nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active (World.enclosed_counting). Such a queue never reaches past its B + B * B-th member (Queue.reached, ChangeBound.joins, ChangeBound.reach), and on those places (placesBelow, FiniteQueue, World.finiteQueue) it is a finite world meeting all eight premises (World.finiteQueue_finite, World.finiteQueue_premised), so finite worlds have the same laws of counting (World.finite_counting), and worlds enclosed from some step on and finite worlds have the same laws of counting (World.enclosed_iff_finite_counting). In the finite queue dissipation binds and the bound is attained: with one member replaced across the first step the front takes two units from the closed family of all places (World.replaced, World.finite_dissipation_binds), and what stands at the first step totals two, one member with one step of change behind it making two at every later step (World.replaced_attains). That change does not recur cannot be strengthened to an end step: if every tally with a change bound from the first step in which nothing joins an empty queue had a step after which nothing changes, or every finite world meeting the eight premises with decided activity a step after which nothing arises, the limited principle of omniscience LPO would hold, the witness replacing one member at the first true of a Boolean sequence (Swap, ChangeBound.lpo_of_ends, World.lpo_of_finite_ends). Under each selection of the premises: at an enclosed step balance, dissipation and embodiment suffice, for with nothing active the total standing there is nothing and any member coming to stand would lower it, so nothing arises, whoever gives and whoever takes (World.enclosed_binds_counting). Whatever its counts, the enclosed queue takes only while active (World.enclosedQueue_taking), and it dissipates step by step, asking only that nothing join an empty queue at the step and that both steps stay within what stands (World.enclosedQueue_dissipatesOn). A queue closing at step T (EnclosedQueue.closing, World.closingQueue) has every relatum exchange a unit each way with the front before T, so no family is closed before T; it balances (World.closingQueue_balanced), from T on its flow is the enclosed queue's (World.closing_flows) and every step is enclosed (World.closingQueue_enclosed), and with a change bound from T and nothing joining an empty queue from then on it dissipates (World.closingQueue_dissipative). Say a selection bounds change (World.BoundsChange) when it selects balance, embodiment and dissipation. So in worlds with every step from some step on enclosed, under each selection of the eight premises a pointwise property of the counts holds of every census of every world meeting the selection exactly when it holds of every tally meeting two conditions: where the selection binds counting, nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active; where it bounds change, from some step T on change stays within a bound and nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active (World.enclosed_counting_under). The second condition carries its step: that change does not recur within the bound (ChangeBound.not_recurring) gives no such step by itself. Without dissipation enclosure leaves counting free: the enclosed queue with bound zero counts every tally meeting the other conditions; without balance or embodiment the still queues are enclosed at every step (World.still_enclosed). So under enclosure a change bound from some step, with nothing arising from then on across a step at which nothing is active, is a law of counting under a selection exactly when it bounds change (World.enclosed_change_bound_iff): where it does not, a count growing by one at every step is counted by a world meeting the selection and enclosed from some step on. Every step of a finite world is enclosed (World.Finite.enclosed), so there balance, embodiment and dissipation by themselves bind counting (World.enclosed_binds_counting) and bound change from the first step (World.enclosure_bounds_change), and every census counts at most as many as there are relata (World.Finite.census_bounded). Conversely, seat the members of a queue in turn round a ring of N places (Ring.slot: member k + 1 sits at the place after member k's, back at the first place once the ring is full); members less than a full turn apart sit at different places (Ring.slot_add, Ring.slot_ne, Ring.slot_inj). Where at most M are in the queue at each step, a ring of 2M + 1 places (Ring.size) holds those in it before or after any step, so the ring lists the places held at each step, each once (Ring.census), and counts what the queue counts (Ring.counts). A ring with nothing standing meets every premise but embodiment (World.ring, World.ring_meets); a ring each of whose places stands at one while held, every premise but balance (World.embodiedRing, World.embodiedRing_meets); and with its front's place also taking from each place what that place's standing loses and giving what it gains, every premise but dissipation, only active relata giving where nothing joins an empty queue (World.balancedRing, World.balancedRing_acting, World.balancedRing_meets). So in finite worlds, under each selection of the eight premises, a pointwise property of the counts holds of every census of every finite world meeting the selection exactly when it holds of every tally meeting three conditions: at most some number active at each step; where the selection binds counting or bounds change, nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active; where it bounds change, change within a bound from the first step (World.finite_counting_under). That nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active is a law in finite worlds under a selection exactly when it selects balance and embodiment, and only active relata giving or dissipation (World.finite_counting_binds_iff); a change bound from the first step is a law exactly where the selection bounds change, one member replaced at every step being counted by a finite ring meeting any other selection (World.finite_change_bound_iff). So in finite worlds the 256 selections give three kinds of law. Finite worlds and worlds enclosed from some step on have the same laws of counting under a selection exactly when it bounds change and binds counting (World.enclosed_iff_finite_counting_under): where it does not bound change, a count growing by one at every step is counted by a world enclosed at every step and by no finite world; where it bounds change without binding counting, one relatum arising from none before enclosure (Queue.lone_settles) is counted by an enclosed world and by no finite world. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 列出与可判定：同 whole-law-of-counting；读于世界时是活动可判定。这是表示的逻辑承诺。
hypotheses.en: Listing and decidability: as in whole-law-of-counting; read of worlds, decided activity. It is a logical commitment of the representation.

hypotheses.zh: 逐点（Pointwise）：同 whole-law-of-counting，代替函数外延性，是定理的假设。
hypotheses.en: Pointwise: as in whole-law-of-counting, in place of function extensionality, a hypothesis of the theorems.

hypotheses.zh: 被围住与有限：从某步起每步被围住、世界有限，是世界的条件，作为定理的假设陈述，不是公理。
hypotheses.en: Enclosure and finiteness: every step from some step on enclosed, or the world finite, are conditions on worlds, stated as hypotheses of the theorems, not axioms.

correspondence.zh: 静止定理（ceasing-needs-arising、continued-change-needs-openness）说被围住时变化不再复现；本结果给出它的定量形式，以及它在计数上的全部内容：被围住的展开中，计数只多受一个变化界约束，其余由计数表与八个前提给出（whole-law-of-counting）；在全部八个前提之下，在计数上有限世界与从某步起被围住的世界无法区分，在一个前提选择之下恰在它约束变化且约束计数时无法区分；被围住所加的恰在选中平衡、体现与耗散时出现，有限所加的还有计数的界，以及耗散从第一步起对生起的约束。作者的读法（AI 论证）：变化界就是被围住时所立者总水平的逐步耗散在计数上的样子；在被围住的展开中，每一次形成或消解都耗去关系中立着的一些东西，能不息地变化的是开放的展开（continued-change-needs-openness）；没有耗散，封闭的家族可以不取用而给予，被围住就不再约束计数；有限的世界从第一步起就被围住，所以在那里不需要只有活跃者取用，耗散连同平衡与体现就使生起需要在场者。这是活动的计数，英文名称 arising/ceasing 经 Ren 确认（2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names；中文 生起／止息 是 AI 的译名）；它是否为 Ren 提议中的“生成的”“退化的”由 Ren 选择（Ren 写道“generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”，以“吧”预设二者不重叠；若取不重叠，这一读法就不是其所指，这是 AI 的推论）；它也不评价生起、止息或静止。
correspondence.en: The rest theorem (ceasing-needs-arising, continued-change-needs-openness) says change does not recur under enclosure; this result gives its quantitative form and all it says of counting: in an enclosed unfolding the counts are constrained by a change bound and by nothing more than the tally and the eight premises (whole-law-of-counting); under all eight premises, in counting, finite worlds cannot be told from worlds enclosed from some step on, and under a selection of the premises they cannot be told apart exactly where it bounds change and binds counting; what enclosure adds appears exactly where balance, embodiment and dissipation are selected, and finiteness adds a bound on the count and the constraint of dissipation on arising from the first step. The author's reading (an AI argument): the change bound is what the stepwise dissipation of the total standing under enclosure looks like in the counts; in an enclosed unfolding every forming or dissolving spends something standing in the relations, and what can change without end is the open unfolding (continued-change-needs-openness); without dissipation a closed family can be given to without taking, and enclosure no longer constrains counting; a finite world is enclosed from the first step, so there only active relata taking is not needed: dissipation with balance and embodiment already makes arising need what is present. This is the counting of activity, whose English names arising and ceasing Ren confirmed (2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names; the Chinese 生起／止息 being the AI's rendering); whether it is the proposal's generative and degenerative is Ren's to choose (Ren wrote ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’, a tag question presuming that they do not overlap; if non-overlap is taken, this reading is not what is meant, the AI's inference); it evaluates neither arising, ceasing nor rest.

detail.zh: 复用计数表与队列（Tally、Queue.holds、Queue.line、Queue.listed、Queue.counts、Queue.ceasings_eq、Queue.comings_eq、Queue.kept_end）、逐点、World.CountsObey、counting_binds_jointly 与队首的引理（OpenQueue.front、OpenQueue.occupied）。
detail.en: Reuses tallies and queues (Tally, Queue.holds, Queue.line, Queue.listed, Queue.counts, Queue.ceasings_eq, Queue.comings_eq, Queue.kept_end), Pointwise, World.CountsObey, counting_binds_jointly and the front lemmas (OpenQueue.front, OpenQueue.occupied).

output.zh: 全部八个前提之下计数的规律恰是计数表与没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起。
output.en: Under all eight premises the laws of counting are the tally and that nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active.

input.zh: 从某步起每步被围住或世界有限时，再加从第 0 步起的变化界。
input.en: With every step from some step on enclosed, or a finite world, a change bound from the first step as well.

conditions.zh: 列出；可判定；逐点；八个前提。
conditions.en: Listing; decidability; pointwise; the eight premises.

detail.zh: 复用所立者的总水平跨过被围住的步不升、任何水平变化都使它下降（Flow.standing_never_rises、Flow.change_lowers）、由活动的普查得到所立者的普查（World.standingCensus、Web.StandingCensus.stock_eq）、被围住的步不是不围住所立者（Flow.Enclosed.aroundStanding_not_not）与体现的生起与止息即上升与下降（World.rises_of_arises、World.falls_of_ceases）。
detail.en: Reuses that across an enclosed step the total standing never rises and every change of standing lowers it (Flow.standing_never_rises, Flow.change_lowers), the census of what stands from the census of activity (World.standingCensus, Web.StandingCensus.stock_eq), that an enclosed step is not refutably enclosed around what stands (Flow.Enclosed.aroundStanding_not_not), and that embodied arising and ceasing are rising and falling (World.rises_of_arises, World.falls_of_ceases).

output.zh: 被围住时变化不再复现（静止定理）。
output.en: Under enclosure change does not recur (the rest theorem).

input.zh: 活跃者连同有变化的步不多于被围住时所立者的总水平。
input.en: The relata active together with the steps of change stay within the total standing at enclosure.

conditions.zh: 活动的普查；关系项都体现；平衡；耗散；被围住。
conditions.en: A census of activity; every relatum embodied; balance; dissipation; enclosure.

detail.zh: 复用八个前提（World.Premised、World.Premised.of）与有限世界每步被围住（World.Finite.enclosed）。
detail.en: Reuses the eight premises (World.Premised, World.Premised.of) and that every step of a finite world is enclosed (World.Finite.enclosed).

output.zh: 八个前提；有限世界每步被围住。
output.en: The eight premises; every step of a finite world enclosed.

input.zh: 被围住的队列满足八个前提；有限世界的计数在变化界之内。
input.en: The enclosed queue meets the eight; change in a finite world is bounded.

detail.zh: 复用封闭与耗散（Flow.ClosedAt、Flow.Dissipative、Flow.DissipatesOn）、总量的引理（total_le_of_support、total_eq_zero、le_total_of_mem）与成员的判定（decideMem）。
detail.en: Reuses closure and dissipation (Flow.ClosedAt, Flow.Dissipative, Flow.DissipatesOn), lemmas on totals (total_le_of_support, total_eq_zero, le_total_of_mem) and deciding membership (decideMem).

output.zh: 耗散只约束有封闭的有限家族的步。
output.en: Dissipation binds only at steps with a closed finite family.

input.zh: 被围住的队列在每个有变化的步上取用的多于给予的。
input.en: At every step of change the enclosed queue takes more than it gives.

detail.zh: 复用计数（mark、mark_iff、mark_pos、mark_le_one、comings、ceasings）、步段（steps_last、steps_mem）与有限全知原则（LPO、clear、Clear）。
detail.en: Reuses the counts (mark, mark_iff, mark_pos, mark_le_one, comings, ceasings), stretches (steps_last, steps_mem) and the limited principle of omniscience (LPO, clear, Clear).

output.zh: 开始与不再成立的计数；LPO。
output.en: Counts of coming and ceasing to be; LPO.

input.zh: 变化界中有变化的步数；终结之步蕴含 LPO。
input.en: The steps of change within a change bound; an end step implies LPO.

detail.zh: 计划 P35：被围住时与有限世界中计数的全部规律；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: Plan P35: the whole law of counting under enclosure and in finite worlds; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.

detail.zh: 那里的 Web.lpo_of_ending 对一个网说终结之步需要全知；本结果对变化界之内的计数与满足八个前提的有限世界说同样的话。
detail.en: Web.lpo_of_ending there says an end step needs omniscience for one web; this result says the same of counts with a change bound and of finite worlds meeting the eight premises.

detail.zh: Swap 与 ChangeBound.lpo_of_ends：在布尔序列的第一个真处替换一个成员的计数在变化界二之内，变化不复现，而对每个这样的计数构造性地给出终结之步就是 LPO。
detail.en: Swap with ChangeBound.lpo_of_ends: replacing one member at the first true of a Boolean sequence has its change bounded by two and change does not recur there, while an end step constructed for every such count is LPO.

detail.zh: World.replaced_attains：变化界的界可以用尽，enclosure_bounds_change 不能加强；World.lpo_of_finite_ends：满足八个前提的有限世界中，此后不再生起之步一般地需要全知。
detail.en: World.replaced_attains: the bound is attained, so enclosure_bounds_change cannot be strengthened; World.lpo_of_finite_ends: in finite worlds meeting the eight premises a step after which nothing arises needs omniscience in general.

detail.zh: World.closingQueue 与 World.enclosed_counting_under：选中平衡、体现与耗散而只有活跃者给予与只有活跃者取用都不选时，被围住之前的生起不受约束，在第 T 步闭合的队列中 T 之前可以有成员加入空队；不选耗散时，变化界为零的被围住的队列实现每个计数表，被围住不加任何规律。
detail.en: World.closingQueue and World.enclosed_counting_under: with balance, embodiment and dissipation selected but neither only active relata giving nor taking, arising before enclosure is unconstrained, members joining an empty queue before step T in the queue closing at T; without dissipation, the enclosed queue with bound zero counts every tally, and enclosure adds no law.

detail.zh: World.finite_change_bound_iff 与 World.enclosed_iff_finite_counting_under：每步替换一个成员的计数由满足除体现、除平衡或除耗散外全部前提的有限的环实现，所以变化界只在选择约束变化时是有限世界的规律；每步多一个的计数由每步被围住的队列实现，Queue.lone_settles 的一个关系项在被围住之前从无到有地生起，所以在其余的选择之下有限世界与被围住的世界的计数规律不同。
detail.en: World.finite_change_bound_iff and World.enclosed_iff_finite_counting_under: one member replaced at every step is counted by finite rings meeting every premise but embodiment, balance or dissipation, so a change bound is a law of finite worlds only where the selection bounds change; a count growing by one at every step is counted by queues enclosed at every step, and in Queue.lone_settles one relatum arises from none before enclosure, so under the other selections finite and enclosed worlds have different laws of counting.

limitations.zh: 只对离散步与每步有限的活动陈述；要求可判定（逻辑承诺）与逐点（代替函数外延性）；只说活动的计数，水平与依存的计数在前提之下没有陈述；变化界以被围住时所立者的总水平为界，可以用尽，但不是每个世界的值；界数的是有变化的步，不是事件；被围住的队列中活动需要支持与有界传递空成立（没有什么依存于什么），每个前提都起约束时计数的全部规律见 whole-law-of-counting（World.binding_counting，相对于 World.Binds），只多出有某个生起，而被围住且每个前提都起约束时的规律没有陈述；没有有限世界使每个前提都起约束（World.Finite.not_binds），有限世界中除普查外每个前提都起约束时的规律没有陈述；变化不复现，终结之步一般地需要全知；每个选择之下被围住时的规律已给出，其中约束变化的条件带着它的步陈述；有限世界中每个选择之下的规律已给出，有限的见证是位置数由每步在队中的数目之界定下的环；不评价生起、止息或静止；名称（occurrences、ChangeBound、EnclosedQueue、enclosedQueue、FiniteQueue、finiteQueue、placesBelow、Swap、replaced、closingQueue、BoundsChange、Ring、slot、ring、embodiedRing、balancedRing）是 AI 按 Ren 2026-10-10 的命名准则所选（零公理部分取描述抽象动力学的形式词，不以社会或金融的词为首选），读法仍由 Ren 定。
limitations.en: Stated for discrete steps and activity finite at each step; needs decidability (a logical commitment) and pointwise properties (in place of function extensionality); speaks only of the counting of activity, the counts of standing and dependence under the premises not being stated; the change bound is the total standing at enclosure, which can be attained but is not the value in every world; the bound counts steps of change, not events; in the enclosed queue activity needing support and bounded transmission hold vacuously (nothing depends on anything), and the whole law of counting where every premise binds is in whole-law-of-counting (World.binding_counting, relative to World.Binds), adding only that something arises, while the laws under enclosure where every premise binds are not stated; no finite world binds every premise (World.Finite.not_binds), and the laws in finite worlds where every premise but the census binds are not stated; change does not recur, and an end step needs omniscience in general; the laws under each selection with enclosure are given, the condition where change is bounded stated with its step; the laws under each selection in finite worlds are given, the finite witnesses being rings whose number of places is set by a bound on how many are in the queue at each step; evaluates neither arising, ceasing nor rest; the names (occurrences, ChangeBound, EnclosedQueue, enclosedQueue, FiniteQueue, finiteQueue, placesBelow, Swap, replaced, closingQueue, BoundsChange, Ring, slot, ring, embodiedRing, balancedRing) are the AI's choice under Ren's naming criteria of 10 October (in the zero-axiom part, formal words describing the abstract dynamics, social and financial words not the first choice), and readings remain Ren's.

The drafts were checked by the thirteenth independent review (BECOMING-P32-P34-REVIEW.md) and rebuilt following its U4–U6; the rebuilt result has no independent review yet, and the author's counterreview is in §49, §52 and §54 of the integration note. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 37 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

history.zh: 2026-10-10 P41b：处理第十四次独立审查（BECOMING-P34B-P38C-REVIEW.md）。新增 World.enclosed_change_bound_iff：被围住时变化界恰在选择约束变化时是规律（原先只在散文中说“恰”）；局限与下一步中“每个前提都起约束时计数的全部规律没有陈述”在 P38c 之后已过时，改为指向 whole-law-of-counting，并列出被围住时与有限世界中仍开放的起约束规律（World.Finite.not_binds）；“空成立”的英文改为 vacuously。作者说明见整合文档 §58。验证范围重新指向回执 20261010T150853.470895Z 与外围回执 20261010T151108.093153Z。
history.en: 2026-10-10 P41b: integrating the fourteenth independent review (BECOMING-P34B-P38C-REVIEW.md). Adds World.enclosed_change_bound_iff: under enclosure the change bound is a law exactly where the selection bounds change (the "exactly" was before said in prose only); the limitations and next step, which after P38c wrongly said the whole law of counting where every premise binds is not stated, now point to whole-law-of-counting and list the binding laws still open under enclosure and in finite worlds (World.Finite.not_binds); "hold idly" becomes "hold vacuously". The author's note is in §58 of the integration note. Validation scope re-pointed to receipt 20261010T150853.470895Z and periphery receipt 20261010T151108.093153Z.
